records.issue_text: VerifyMessageProperties.java normalizeValue() replaces entire choice expressions with `...`, discarding branch contents and allowing unsafe HTML to pass verification.
records.rationale: The finding misunderstands the purpose of normalizeValue(). The method replaces choice expressions with '...' specifically to AVOID false positives during HTML sanitization - the '<' character in choice syntax like '{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}' would otherwise be incorrectly flagged as HTML.
